headline: Executive order directs changes to federal rules that limit access to federal lands, based on its title.
what_it_does: Based only on its title, this order aims to remove or loosen certain federal restrictions on access to federal lands. No summary was provided, so it is not clear which lands, which restrictions, or what kinds of access are covered.

who_it_affects.group: People and businesses who use federal lands
who_it_affects.how: They may face fewer limits on entering or using federal lands, depending on which restrictions the order targets.
They will likely be directed to review and possibly change their rules on access to federal lands.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 29, 2026; specific deadlines are not known from the title alone.
